Moved `charge()`, `refund()`, and `validate_card()` into `payments/core.py`; `checkout.py` now imports from it. `webhook_handler()` remains in `checkout.py` (coupled to Flask request object).

Test results: 47/48 pass. `test_refund_partial` fails — pre-existing failure unrelated to this refactor (asserts rounding behavior changed in 2.1 release).
